arxiv_queries: Under v_-(omega)>0, if a belongs to the envelope full-mass class E(X,omega), b belongs to PSH(X,omega), at least one of their non-pluripolar measures has finite total mass, and 1_{a<b}(omega+dd^c a)^n <= kappa 1_{a<b}(omega+dd^c b)^n with 0<=kappa<1, then a>=b. Alehyane Lu Salouf Theorem 3.14.

For a nonzero non-pluripolar positive Radon measure nu on a compact Hermitian manifold with v_-(omega)>0, the equation (omega+dd^c a)^n=c nu has a solution a in E(X,omega) and a unique possible positive constant c. Alehyane Lu Salouf Theorem 5.8 Corollary 5.9.

The exponentially twisted complex Monge-Ampere equation (omega+dd^c u)^n=e^{lambda u}mu with lambda>0 has a unique solution in the envelope full-mass class under v_-(omega)>0. Alehyane Lu Salouf Theorem 5.8.
